verdict.rationale: Apify is a web-crawling platform, so query-aware adaptive crawling is a fair axis. The evidence only shows a fixed page cap (maxCrawlPages) and result limits. These are static limits set in advance, not crawling that judges when enough information has been gathered for a query. No documented adaptive or query-sufficiency stopping exists in the pack.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can rely on adaptive crawling that automatically stops once enough information has been gathered to answer my query
